in_hebrew.name: Rollie
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Wheel, Ruler, Powerful
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rollie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'hrollan' meaning 'to wheel' or 'to roll'. This name can also be derived from the Old Norse name 'Rögnvaldr' meaning 'counsel-ruler'. The name Rollie signifies power, strength, and leadership. It is a name of freedom and joy.

This name can also be derived from the Old Norse name 'Rögnvaldr' meaning 'counsel-ruler'. The name Rollie signifies power, strength, and leadership. It is a name of freedom and joy.
